errors.text_span: Im rechten Diagramm sind die einzelnen Anteile der Bund, Länder und Gemeinden sowie die Gesamtausgaben der Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt als separate Linien dargestellt
errors.evidence: In the right diagram, the data is not represented as separate lines for Bund, Länder, and Gemeinden; instead, it is shown as stacked bars with a single black line for Gesamtausgaben.
The machine-generated description does not specify that the left diagram represents gross fixed capital investments and the right diagram represents net fixed capital investments.

The machine-generated description does not mention the significant differences in values between the gross and net investments, such as the gross investments being above 3% in the early 1990s and the net investments being much lower, often below 0.5%.

The machine-generated description does not highlight the trend of gross investments stabilizing between 2% and 3% after 2000, nor the net investments fluctuating between 0% and 0.5% with occasional negative values.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly mention that the vertical axis represents percentages of GDP.
